collections.title: Optimization · Convexity, Algorithms, and Duality
assumed_background: Functions, inequalities and algebra; calculus and linear algebra for gradient and matrix examples.

collections.title: Optimization · Submodular and Discrete Guarantees
assumed_background: Finite sets, combinatorics, relaxations and the meaning of approximation guarantees.

collections.title: Optimization · Monotone and Stochastic Algorithms
assumed_background: Convexity, gradients, proximal maps, operator norms and probability for noisy oracles.

collections.title: Optimization · Sensitivity, Robustness, and Risk
assumed_background: Convex duality and probability/expectation; transport and risk definitions are developed in the lectures.

collections.title: Optimization · Conic Geometry and Exact Certificates
assumed_background: Linear and semidefinite programming, dual cones and the distinction between mathematical and numerical feasibility.

collections.title: Optimization · Why Curvature Controls Algorithms
collections.summary: Start from first-order descent, then work out Hessian anisotropy, convergence certificates, preconditioning and ridge shrinkage.
assumed_background: Two-variable derivatives and Hessians, elementary eigenvalues, and squared-error objectives.
